scailCourses.title: AI 101: What Is AI and Why Should I Care?
scailCourses.description: A plain-language introduction to artificial intelligence designed for community members with zero prior experience. This session demystifies AI using everyday examples and ends with a hands-on ChatGPT demo.
scailCourses.audience: Community members with zero AI experience, all ages
modules: Module 1: What AI actually is (in plain language)
Module 2: AI you already use (Siri, Netflix, Google Maps)
outcomes: Use ChatGPT for a real task
Identify 3 AI tools in daily life
scailCourses.materials: Projector, printed handouts, community center space

scailCourses.title: AI for Your Job: Practical Skills Workshop
scailCourses.description: A half-day hands-on workshop helping working adults and job seekers apply AI tools to real workplace tasks — from writing professional emails to improving resumes and finding job opportunities.
modules: Module 1: AI tools for common jobs (admin, healthcare, agriculture, retail)
Module 4: Using AI for job searches
outcomes: Use AI to write a professional email
Identify AI tools for their specific job
scailCourses.materials: Laptops or tablets (provided), Wi-Fi, printed exercise sheets

scailCourses.title: AI for Small Business Owners
scailCourses.description: A four-week hybrid course that walks local business owners and entrepreneurs through practical AI adoption — covering marketing, operations, customer service, and long-term AI strategy.
modules: Week 1: AI for marketing (social media, ads)
Week 3: AI for customer service (chatbots, email)
outcomes: Implement at least 2 AI tools in their business
scailCourses.materials: Laptops or tablets, Wi-Fi, workbook with weekly exercises

scailCourses.title: AI for Farmers and Agriculture
scailCourses.description: A half-day workshop tailored to South Carolina's agricultural community, covering precision agriculture tools, crop monitoring, livestock management, and how to find grants and subsidies using AI.
scailCourses.audience: Farmers, agricultural workers, South Carolina land owners
outcomes: Use at least 1 agricultural AI tool
Understand how AI can reduce costs
scailCourses.materials: Projector, printed reference sheets, demo devices

scailCourses.title: AI Safety and Digital Literacy
scailCourses.description: A two-hour community safety workshop focused on helping all residents — especially seniors — recognize AI-generated scams, protect their personal data, and understand the limits of AI trust.
modules: Module 5: When NOT to trust AI
outcomes: Set up basic digital safety practices
scailCourses.materials: Projector, printed safety checklist handouts, example screenshots of scams

scailCourses.title: Youth AI Lab: Build Your First AI Project
scailCourses.description: A six-week in-person program for young people ages 14-22 that takes them from AI basics through ethics, prompt engineering, no-code tools, and culminates in a live demo day showcasing their own AI-powered project.
outcomes: Build and present an AI-powered project
scailCourses.materials: Laptops (provided), Wi-Fi, no-code platform accounts, project workbooks

scailCourses.title: AI Leadership Academy
scailCourses.description: An eight-week hybrid program for community leaders, aspiring entrepreneurs, and nonprofit staff who want to lead AI adoption in their organizations. Culminates in a capstone project and pitch deck.
scailCourses.audience: Community leaders, aspiring entrepreneurs, nonprofit staff
outcomes: Create an AI implementation plan for their organization
Pitch deck for an AI-enabled venture
scailCourses.materials: Laptops, workbook, access to premium AI tools (trial accounts), guest speaker sessions

scailCourses.title: Train the Trainer: AI Education Certification
scailCourses.description: A 12-week hybrid certification program that equips teachers, librarians, and community educators to independently deliver SCAiL workshops. Graduates earn the SCAiL-certified AI Educator credential.
modules: Module 2: Teaching AI to non-technical audiences
outcomes: Ability to deliver SCAiL workshops independently
scailCourses.materials: Full facilitator guide, slide decks, handout templates, certification assessment, access to SCAiL trainer portal

externalCourses.title: AI for Everyone
externalCourses.description: A non-technical course by Andrew Ng covering what AI can and cannot do, how to build AI projects, and how to work with an AI team. One of the most widely recommended AI introductions available.
externalCourses.whyIncluded: The gold standard intro to AI for non-technical audiences

externalCourses.title: Generative AI for Everyone
externalCourses.description: A follow-up to AI for Everyone, focused specifically on generative AI — how it works, how to use it, and how to think about its impact on work and society.

externalCourses.title: Elements of AI
externalCourses.description: A free online course created by the University of Helsinki and Reaktor, designed to demystify AI for everyone. No math or programming required. Has reached over 2 million students worldwide.
externalCourses.whyIncluded: 2M+ students, no math/code, model for SCAiL curriculum

externalCourses.title: Crash Course AI
externalCourses.description: A 20-episode YouTube series from CrashCourse covering AI topics in a fun, visual, and accessible format. Covers machine learning, neural networks, natural language processing, and more.

externalCourses.title: Google AI Professional Certificate
externalCourses.description: A professional certificate program from Google covering AI fundamentals, machine learning, and practical AI tools within the Google ecosystem. Designed for working professionals.

externalCourses.title: Google AI Essentials
externalCourses.description: A short, practical course from Google on using AI tools for everyday work tasks — writing, research, data analysis, and problem-solving. Designed for non-technical professionals.

externalCourses.title: Google Skillshop AI Courses
externalCourses.description: A collection of 14 free AI courses from Google's official learning platform, covering Google AI tools, responsible AI, and practical applications. All courses include free certificates upon completion.

externalCourses.title: OpenAI Academy
externalCourses.description: OpenAI's official free learning platform offering hands-on training in using ChatGPT and other OpenAI tools. Includes educator-focused content and certifications expected in 2026.
externalCourses.whyIncluded: Free hands-on training, educator focus, certifications coming 2026

externalCourses.title: Career Essentials in Generative AI
externalCourses.description: A free professional certificate jointly offered by Microsoft and LinkedIn covering generative AI concepts, responsible AI use, and practical applications for career growth.

externalCourses.title: IBM AI Foundations for Everyone
externalCourses.description: A specialization from IBM covering AI concepts, machine learning, and natural language processing without requiring programming knowledge. Includes a hands-on project to build a chatbot without code.

externalCourses.title: IBM AI Fundamentals
externalCourses.description: A free AI fundamentals course from IBM's SkillsBuild platform covering AI concepts, applications, ethics, and career pathways. Earners receive a free digital credential upon completion.

externalCourses.title: No-Code ML and GenAI on AWS
externalCourses.description: A collection of free courses from Amazon Web Services focused on building machine learning models and generative AI applications without writing code, using AWS tools like SageMaker Canvas.

externalCourses.title: 3Blue1Brown Neural Networks
externalCourses.description: A beautifully animated YouTube series by Grant Sanderson (3Blue1Brown) explaining how neural networks work at an intuitive mathematical level. The clearest visual explanation of deep learning fundamentals available.
externalCourses.whyIncluded: Best visual explanation of how AI works

externalCourses.title: IBM Technology AI Playlist
externalCourses.description: IBM Technology's YouTube channel features a curated playlist of AI explainer videos covering everything from AI basics to specific tools and enterprise use cases. Absolute beginner friendly.

externalCourses.title: AI Academy Piloting AI
externalCourses.description: SmarterX AI Academy offers 18 structured courses covering AI literacy, practical AI tools, and professional application. Includes professional certificates and an explicit nonprofit partnership program with discounted pricing.
externalCourses.whyIncluded: 18 courses, professional certificates, explicit nonprofit partnership program

externalCourses.title: SmarterX Intro to AI
externalCourses.description: A free monthly live introductory AI class from SmarterX open to anyone. Has attracted over 40,000 registrants, making it one of the most popular free AI literacy events available.

externalCourses.title: Khan Academy AI for Education
externalCourses.description: Khan Academy offers free AI literacy lesson plans and resources for K-12 students and teachers, including teacher certification programs for using AI responsibly in the classroom.
externalCourses.whyIncluded: K-12 lesson plans and teacher certification

externalCourses.title: fast.ai Practical Deep Learning
externalCourses.description: A free, code-first deep learning course from Jeremy Howard and fast.ai. Teaches practical deep learning using Python and PyTorch. Recommended for Phase 2 incubator participants who want to build AI-powered products.
externalCourses.whyIncluded: For Phase 2 incubator participants who want to build

partnerships.description: SmarterX offers an explicit nonprofit pricing model (50% off first license, $299/user for groups) through their AI Literacy Project, which aligns directly with SCAiL's mission to bring AI education to underserved communities.
partnerships.notes: Explicit nonprofit pricing (50% off first license, $299/user for groups). AI Literacy Project aligns with SCAiL mission. Contact: smarterx.ai/contact-ai-literacy

partnerships.description: OpenAI Academy offers free content, in-person workshop partnership programs, and dedicated teacher programs backed by a $10M investment in AI teacher education. A potential anchor curriculum partner for SCAiL.
partnerships.notes: Free content, in-person workshop partnerships, teacher programs, $10M teacher investment

partnerships.description: aiEDU is an AI education nonprofit focused on equitable access to AI literacy. Potential for curriculum sharing, co-development, and mission alignment as SCAiL scales its educator training programs.
partnerships.notes: AI education nonprofit, potential curriculum sharing

partnerships.description: Khan Academy provides free AI literacy lesson plans for K-12 and a teacher certification program. A natural partner for SCAiL's youth programs and Train the Trainer certification pathway.
partnerships.notes: Free AI literacy lesson plans for K-12, teacher certification program

partnerships.description: Google for Nonprofits provides technology grants and partnerships, while the Google AI Professional Certificate and free Skillshop courses offer credentialing pathways. Google's small business AI programs align with SCAiL's entrepreneur track.
partnerships.notes: Google for Nonprofits, AI Professional Certificate, free for small businesses

partnerships.description: IBM SkillsBuild offers free AI credentials for adult learners and job seekers, making it an ideal partner for SCAiL's workforce development programs targeting underemployed community members in South Carolina.
partnerships.notes: Free AI credentials for adult learners and job seekers
